text.description_html:
Laurey 57104, Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Satin Brass

The Small Satin Brass Newport Cabinet Pull has 96mm center to centers. The Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Satin Brass comes packaged with mounting hardware. The 96mm Newport Pull Satin Brass can be used as a kitchen cabinet pull or also in the bathroom or on furniture.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57104 96mm Pull Newport Satin Brass:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3.78" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4.61"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
